chunks: And it has been narrated: “Indeed, al-madhy and al-wadhy are like saliva and mucus, so neither the garment nor the urethral outlet is washed because of them.”
ai.seo_question: Do al-madhy and al-wadhy make clothing or the private part impure?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that al-madhy and al-wadhy are treated like saliva and mucus in ritual purity. Therefore, their presence does not require washing the garment or the urethral outlet.
